Loading Pipettes

When writing a protocol, you must inform the Protocol API about the pipettes you will be using. See InstrumentContext and the pipette catalog.

API load names¶

Choose the tab for your robot.

# Flex 1-Channel in the left mount
pipette = protocol.load_instrument("flex_1channel_1000", "left")

# OT-2 single-channel GEN2
pipette = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right")

OT-2 notes

GEN1 pipettes are also supported.

Warning

Do not load two pipettes on the same mount.

protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left")  # second load fails

Steps¶

  1. Attach the pipette.

    • Check the mount.
    • Run calibration.
  2. Load it in your protocol.
    Then simulate.
